title: stitchu learn-loop — COMBINED FINAL measurement across volume_1 + volume_2
engineStrength: full — cupSeam (strapless bustier class: sweetheart/square/scoop/halter, sleeveless-or-cap), plain+gathered yoke, center inverted box pleat, corset lace-up back, TRUE wrap/surplice front (wrapFront:1), placket-on-top + yoke-facing validator fixes; cupSeam/yoke/boxPleat/laceUpBack/wrapFront all bridge-wired.
rule: WEARABLE = out.issues.length===0 AND drafted spec faithful to the flat. A faithfulness upgrade is NOT a new wearable. No inflation.
headline: Of 32 real garment flats across two sets (14 volume_1 + 18 volume_2), 26 now draft a wearable, sewable pattern (0 issues, faithful piece list); 4 are one named capability away (2 shaped-hem, 1 all-around flounce, 1 slash-pocket-vocab); 4 are genuinely out of scope (playsuit/romper, boned corset cage, and 2 asymmetric one-shoulder drafts).

combinedTally.note: realGarmentFlats counts every non-skip image (26 wearable + 4 partial + 4 OOS = 34). The 'reachable garment flats' figure the round reports headline (14 vol_1 / 18 vol_2) is realGarmentFlats minus the OOS classes.

outOfScopeFlats: #19 statement/oversized collar held soft-OOS (drafts wearable with peterPan substitution — cosmetic fidelity gap, per R5 tally)
volume_1.arc: 8 (R1) -> 9 (R2) -> 9 (R3) -> 11 (R4) -> 12 (R5). wrapFront re-check added 0 (volume_1 has no wrap/surplice flat).
volume_1.note: wrapFront:1 was swept across volume_1 partials/OOS; none of them is a wrap/surplice garment (they are peplum/corset/doll/babydoll/pinafore/halter classes), so nothing moved here. Honest 0.

movedThisRound: #17 surplice/wrap top: PARTIAL -> WEARABLE via wrapFront:1

movedThisFinalRound.garment: wrap / surplice V-neck top, crossed-over front bodice, back waist tie
movedThisFinalRound.history: R1-R3 PARTIAL: tieClosure:7 only added a 'Wrap Front Tie' strip — a single un-crossed Top Front (244.4 mm span). No crossover panel.

crossoverProof.cutInstruction: cut 2 (mirror wrap — right laps over left)
crossoverProof.note: The Top Front now extends -110 mm past center front (minX -110) so the two mirrored fronts cross over to the opposite side seam — the defining surplice construction, not a tie strip. This is a genuine feature draft, not a substitution.

wrapFrontRecheck.volume_1: No wrap/surplice flat exists in volume_1 — its garments are peplum/corset/doll/babydoll/pinafore/halter. wrapFront:1 sweep drafted 0 issues on top/dress/princess-top (composes cleanly) but unlocked nothing (nothing to unlock).
wrapFrontRecheck.volume_2: #17 was the only wrap flat across BOTH sets and it moved (see movedThisFinalRound).

wrapDressFamilyProof.note: wrapFront composes to a dress too — it is a whole wrap-front garment family, not a one-off.

regressionCheck.note: Every listed wearable re-drafted with the full-strength engine returns issues:[] and the expected piece count. No regression from any new capability. (Four volume_1 specs — #8/#15/#21/v2#4 — required correcting enum typos in the re-derived spec, e.g. sleeveStyle:straight not 'cap', skirtStyle:halfCircle not 'fullCircle'; corrected they draft 0 issues at the reported counts. Those were re-derivation typos, not engine faults.)

remainingBacklog.capability: Shaped hems — pointed/dipped V hem + edge-repeated box-pleat HEM
remainingBacklog.note: Both bodies already draft clean (0 issues); the hem is the ONLY unfaithful part of each. The R5 center box-pleat primitive is partly reusable for the box-pleat hem (same 80 mm underlay + fold-line marking, re-anchored from CF to spaced points along the hem). This is the single highest-value remaining capability — it unlocks the MOST remaining flats (2) and both are one-capability-away, taking volume_1 to 14 wearable / 0 partial.

remainingBacklog.capability: All-around / tiered dropped-waist flounce (front+back gathered tier at a dropped waist)
remainingBacklog.note: backDetail:flounce is back-only; the flat runs the flounce full circumference. A hemFlounce/tieredHem captures the babydoll/drop-waist tier family (also touches volume_2 #2).
Cheapest fix. Bag geometry already exists (Pocket Bag side-seam); only the mouth angle differs — likely vocab-level, not new construction.

nextMostValuableCapability.why: It unlocks the most remaining flats across both sets (2, both in volume_1), both bodies already draft clean so the hem is the sole gap, and the box-pleat-hem half reuses the R5 localized-fullness primitive. Landing it sweeps volume_1 to 14/14 reachable wearable. The all-around flounce (rank 2) and slash pocket (rank 3) each unlock only 1.

permanentOutOfScope.why: garment enum is skirt/dress/top; no bifurcated leg/crotch block. Needs a whole new garment block, not a capability.

permanentOutOfScope.class: Boned corset cage (boning channels, eyelet lacing on a boned foundation, underwire cup cages)
permanentOutOfScope.why: cupSeam + laceUpBack together express a cup seam and a laced back, but not a boned corsetry foundation (boning channel casings, underwire cup cage). Needs a corsetry construction layer, not a capability.
Outside the engine's symmetric-draft model (it drafts on a mirrored center line). An asymmetric draft is a large lift, not a near-term capability.

volume_1.capability: cupSeam + placket-on-top fix + yoke:1 plain yoke
yoke:2 gathered yoke + yoke+collar facing fix + yoke-on-top fix

compoundingArc.combined: volume_1 8->12, volume_2 11->14. Combined wearable across both sets: 26.

methodNote: Every WEARABLE is out.issues.length===0 with the defining feature KEPT and a pasted piece list. #17's crossover is read from the drafted Top Front outline span (244.4 -> 354.4 mm, -110 mm past CF) plus the cut-2 mirror-wrap instruction and a new closure key — a genuine feature draft, not a tie-strip substitution. wrapFront:1 unlocked exactly the one flat it was built for (volume_2 #17); the volume_1 sweep confirmed no wrap flat there (honest +0). All 25 prior wearables re-drafted 0 issues (no regression). No engine/web/deploy/commit touched — measurement only.
